values.note: $26-42 a night for a water/electric site; full-service sites $36-50. The 18 non-electric sites ($19-28) are the park's tent sites and are not the base. The price changes by site and night, higher on weekends and busy dates. No reservation fee and no out-of-state rate. Calendar read for two weeks from 2026-10-13 and from 2027-06-15 (2026-10-12), rechecked 2026-10-21 ($28-40 water/electric, $40-50 full service, $19-28 non-electric).

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights' (longer in peak season and on holidays); per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights (cumulative 42 of 49, shorter in peak season). Same-day reservations go through the park.

Minimum length of stay is 2 nights'), read 2026-10-21; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

summary: Fees 19-42 -> 26-42 (the $19 low was the non-electric sites, which the park calls tent sites); confirmed reservable on SC's own site, 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver); added water + sewer (amps not stated), 29 RV sites, 14-night max, showers and dump. Note kept. Not stated: amperage, rig length, season, pull-throughs.
